title: How findings are counted, once per axle
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with 'Customers - View' and 'Work orders - View'.
  2. Inspections containing checkbox and per-axle measurement fields with: some responses N/A or unanswered; a per-axle field with three axles marked OK, Monitor and Not OK; and some hidden fields. Seed a template with these field types and set the responses.
custom_steps:
1. Confirm a response counts once toward Pass, Monitor or Needs attention only when the field is visible, is a checkbox or measurement, and the response is Pass/Monitor/Not OK.
2. Confirm N/A and unanswered responses contribute nothing.
3. Confirm a per-axle measurement field contributes one count per axle (three axles OK/Monitor/Not OK → one pass, one monitor, one needs-attention).
4. Confirm the asset list, report summary and Needs action filter all follow this same count.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A response contributes one count to exactly one of Pass, Monitor or Needs attention when the field is visible, is a checkbox or measurement, and the response is Pass, Monitor or Not OK.
  • N/A and unanswered responses contribute nothing to the counts.
  • A per-axle measurement field contributes one count per axle (three axles marked OK, Monitor and Not OK give one pass, one monitor and one needs-attention).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9103 (S5 — Inspection history on the asset record); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S5; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-R17: “A response contributes one count to exactly one of Pass, Monitor or Needs attention when the field is visible, the field is a checkbox or a measurement, and the response is Pass, Monitor or Not OK”
  • S5-R19: “N/A and unanswered responses contribute nothing”
  • S5-R20: “A per-axle measurement field contributes one count per axle, because each axle is a separate inspected position. A field with three axles marked OK, Monitor and Not OK contributes one pass, one monitor and one needs-attention”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
